title: The Stieltjes Bootstrap for Feynman Integrals
summary: We prove that scalar Feynman integrals are Stieltjes functions in each kinematic variable $-p_i\cdot p_j$, as well as in the particle masses, for arbitrary loop order, arbitrary numbers of external legs, and arbitrary internal masses, whenever a certain exponent condition is satisfied. The proof rests on a canonical decomposition of the second Symanzik polynomial with manifestly non-negative coefficients indexed by spanning two-forests.
